description: Query Meituan Travel for flights, trains, hotels, attractions, itineraries, and local transportation.

auth.label: Personal Developer Token
auth.description: Meituan personal developer Token used to query Meituan Travel. Complete personal developer verification and create a Token at https://developer.meituan.com/zh/v2/dev/token. The Token is verified when the first travel query runs because Meituan does not provide a lightweight validation endpoint.

actions.name: query_travel
actions.description: Query Meituan Travel for flights, trains, hotels, attractions, itineraries, local transportation, and other travel information using natural language. Requests may take up to two minutes, so use a caller timeout longer than 120 seconds.

query.description: The user's travel question or request, including useful details such as dates, origin, destination, budget, and number of travelers.

city.description: The user's current city or the city used as context for the travel query. Defaults to Beijing when omitted.

originQuery.description: The complete original user request used for Meituan attribution and analytics. Defaults to query when omitted.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for a Meituan Travel natural-language query.

content.description: The Meituan Travel result as Markdown text, which may include recommendations, prices, images, and booking links.

outputSchema.description: The normalized result returned by Meituan Travel.
